About Our Products and Services

We've been helping Sarasota area, Florida homeowners get their dream kitchens and bathrooms for over 49 years. Just because your kitchen or bathroom doesn't work for you now, doesn't mean it couldn't. That's where we come in. Whether you need more storage, a new floor plan or cabinets, we're here to help every step of the way. We pride ourselves on our 96% budget and scheduling accuracy, ensuring your project stays on track and within budget.

S&W Kitchens offers a comprehensive range of remodeling services to transform your home. Learn more about our specialized services:

Kitchen Remodeling

Our professional kitchen and bath designers will assist you in creating the perfect space for you and your family. Then, we'll bring it to life using top-quality cabinets, proudly made in the USA and fixtures, all put together with laser focused precision and beautiful, professional craftsmanship.

What sets us apart is that we blend our professional remodeling design skills with our construction expertise. When you work with S&W Kitchens, you can expect top-notch customer service and communication.

Our Sarasota design and construction teams are under one roof which means you'll save both time and money. We've got your back for the whole project – whether it's praise or blame, it's all on us.

Hiring a remodeling contractor is a big decision. We want to put your mind at ease that you’re working with an established company that is fully licensed, state-certified, and insured. We take our quality standards very seriously.

We are part of industry groups like the NKBA (National Kitchen & Bath Association), the Florida Home Builders Association, several other local building associations, and we are proud to hold the Certified Aging-in-Place Specialist (CAPS) designation.

At our Sarasota design center, you can explore various cabinet styles, colors, and types in a casual and comfortable setting. Everything's set up like it would be in your own kitchen – cabinets, countertops, and tile selections all in one place. It's the best way to figure out what style suits your perfect kitchen.

And here's the fun part – we can create a virtual kitchen design with state of the art computer technology. That way, you'll get to see the finished project before it’s installed in your home. Cool, right?

We proudly serve the Sarasota metropolitan area and surrounding communities through southwest Florida. Our service area includes: Anna Maria, Bayshore Gardens, Bee Ridge, Bradenton, Bradenton Beach, Cortez, Desoto Lakes, Ellenton, Fruitville, Gulf Gate Estates, Holmes Beach, Kensington Park, Lakewood Ranch, Laurel, Memphis, Nokomis, North Port, North Sarasota, Osprey, Palmetto, Samoset, Sarasota Springs, South Sarasota, The Meadows, Vamo, Venice, Warm Mineral Springs, West Samoset, Siesta Key, South Bradenton, South Gate Ridge, South Venice, West Bradenton, Whitfield, Venice Gardens, Florida and more..

Most Awarded Remodeler In Central Florida:

Why Choose S&W Kitchens

S&W Kitchens is a Florida kitchen, bath and home remodeling company that helps homeowners plan, design, and build a wide range of home renovation and remodeling projects. Thanks to our 49 years of experience, diverse team of professionals, and laser precision estimating, we have the secret sauce to ensure your project is beautifully designed and well-executed from initial consultation to final walk-through.  We’re proud to support American businesses by offering high-quality cabinets that are made in the USA.

 YOUR BUDGET, 
PROTECTED

Home remodels are notorious for coming in over budget. Ours don't. With our meticulous "Project Book" and transparent process, we'll give you a number you can actually count on.

That's why 96% of our projects finish on budget and on schedule.

NO SURPRISES. JUST CLEAR COMMUNICATION.

When you work with S&W, your remodel isn't handed off to a stranger. Our background checked team work together so everyone who touches your home knows the plan, knows the details, and is committed to getting it right. Learn about our process.

49 YEARS. 33 AWARDS. 
7 SHOWROOMS.

Experience matters in remodeling. S&W has been Florida's most trusted remodeler since 1977, earning 33 national awards and growing to 7 showrooms across the state. When you're investing in your home, you deserve a team with a track record to match.

Visit One of Our 7 Florida Showrooms:

Winter Park | Longwood |  Windermere | Melbourne | Palm Harbor | Tampa | Sarasota

Award-Winning Home Remodeling in Florida

Remodeling doesn't have to be stressful, and with the right team, it won't be. You're in the right place.

Since 1977, we've helped thousands of Florida homeowners build kitchens, bathrooms, and homes they love. And with the right team, the remodeling process doesn't have to be stressful. Believe it or not, it can actually be an enjoyable experience. Whether you are looking for a simple refresh or a luxury renovation, we handle everything behind the scenes so you can focus on the fun part: designing the home you've always wanted!

KITCHEN REMODELING

Award-winning designs, from warm-wood classic to modern. 

BATHROOM REMODELING

Spa-like retreats and functional family baths. 

HOME REMODELING

Comprehensive solutions for whole-home renovations and additions.

OUTDOOR KITCHENS

High-end Florida outdoor living and custom entertaining spaces.

Specialty Design Areas

Some projects call for a little more expertise. Here are a few specialized services worth knowing about.

AGING IN PLACE

We believe your forever home should be as functional as it is beautiful. Our designers think through every detail: curbless showers, wider clearance layouts, non-slip flooring that doesn't sacrifice an inch of style. The result is a home that works beautifully for decades to come, guided by our Certified Aging-in-Place Specialist (CAPS).

Aging in Place Services

LUX REMODELS & RENOVATIONS

Some homeowners want beautiful design along with the finest materials available. Our designers work with you to create spaces that are as thoughtfully planned as they are stunning. Through our partnerships with luxury brands like Poggenpohl and Bentwood, we can deliver both, backed by the same care and craftsmanship S&W has brought to Florida homes since 1977. 

See Our Luxury Remodel Projects

CUSTOM CABINETS

We take pride in offering cabinetry that's made right here in America, crafted with care and attention to detail that ensures it's built for the long run. From warm white oak and walnut to clean contemporary finishes, our selection gives you the quality and craftsmanship your home deserves.

Your remodel project isn't just assigned to one person; it will be known and supported by the entire S&W team, ensuring seamless coordination, proactive problem-solving, and consistent quality from design through construction.

Our team is made up of award-winning designers, highly experienced project managers, and skilled construction professionals. For your peace of mind, all team members who may work in your home are background-checked and share our commitment to excellence and client satisfaction.

        "name": "I’m going to remodel my kitchen….Can I do some of the work myself to save money?",

          "text": "Yes. Although we provide all services necessary, we will help coach you through whichever parts of the project you choose to tackle yourself.         "@type": "Question",
        "name": "I’m remodeling my kitchen. Will I have to hire my own electrician and plumber?",
        "acceptedAnswer": {
          "@type": "Answer",
          "text": "No. We offer full service remodeling services. We are a licensed General Contractor and we also hold a state plumbing contractor license. However, if you have a great plumber that you want to use, we will work with your provider."

        "name": "My neighbor got her kitchen from you and spent $ 10,000.00. Can I do my kitchen for the same amount?",
        "acceptedAnswer": {
          "@type": "Answer",
          "text": "Maybe! However, every kitchen is different and every homeowner makes different selections that affect the cost up or down. In the event that we could duplicate exactly what your neighbor did, then yes."
        }

      {
        "@type": "Question",
        "name": "What choices impact the cost of a kitchen remodel the most?",
        "acceptedAnswer": {
          "@type": "Answer",
          "text": "Construction-related costs due to design changes (ie moving your sink to an island, or removing a dropped ceiling) will have the largest impact.         }
      },

        "@type": "Question",

          "text": "Absolutely. We can duplicate the same “footprint” without having to touch the floor. At the same time we can make design and storage changes by reconfiguring the components. For example, fitting a Lazy Susan cabinet in a corner exactly where there was a blind corner base."

A Simple Refresh or Full Transformation

A bathroom remodel or renovation is one of the most exciting transformations you can make in your home. It’s also a significant investment—not just of finances, but of your trust and your time. We understand that you have important questions and high expectations, and you should.

Whether you're looking to update key features or completely reimagine your space, we tailor our approach to fit your specific goals and vision. We typically partner with homeowners in one of three ways: 

Refresh

Perfect for a high-impact that modernizes your space without changing the existing layout.

Full Remodel

Our most popular approach for transforming your bathroom's function and style.

Luxury Remodel

The ultimate bespoke experience for those who desire a truly one-of-a-kind bathroom retreat.

No matter the scale of your project, our promise is to be your dedicated partner on this journey. We replace the uncertainty of remodeling with a transparent, proven process, and we replace the stress of the unknown with constant, clear communication.

From our very first conversation about your ideas to the final walkthrough of your new retreat, our team is here to listen to your needs, guide you with expert advice, and manage every detail with professionalism. Your vision is our blueprint.

Our Remodeling Process

We believe the remodeling experience should be as well-crafted as the final result. We have spent over 49 years perfecting a process that ensures clarity, communication, and peace of mind for our clients.

1

Design Consultation: It starts with a conversation. We visit your  home to measure your space, discuss your goals, and learn about your lifestyle. This ensures the design we create is perfectly tailored to you.

2

Custom Design, Project and Budget Review: Our designers bring your space to life with realistic renderings. You’ll see your new bathroom before construction begins, allowing you to visualize the layout, finishes, and fixtures with confidence.

3

Professional Installation: We handle everything. Your dedicated S&W project manager coordinates our in-house team of installers, ensuring the highest level of service and craftsmanship from demolition to the final tile. Plus we're part of industry groups like the NKBA (National Kitchen & Bath Association), the Florida Home Builders Association, and several other local building associations. Everything You Need For Your Dream Bathroom

Swing by one of our showrooms and explore our extensive selection of kitchen and bath products.  From stunning tiles and backsplashes to beautiful cabinetry, hardware, fixtures, flooring, and beyond – we've got you covered. We know every little detail counts when it comes to transforming your bathroom!

BATHROOM CABINETS & VANITIES

When it comes to your bathroom remodel, cabinets are a game-changer for both style and functionality.

Our seasoned bathroom designers are here to guide you, ensuring you have the perfect solution to fit your needs and budget. 

CABINET REFACING

Revitalize your bathroom with our cabinet refacing services, a smart and cost-effective alternative to a full-scale renovation. Our skilled craftsmen will work their magic to give your cabinets a stunning makeover, with plenty of finishes and styles to choose from, so you can get the exact look you want!

COUNTERTOPS

We offer an extensive selection of premium countertop materials, including granite, quartz, marble, and more. Our countertops are sourced from reputable suppliers, so you know you're getting quality that'll last. Our team of pros is here to help you pick the perfect countertop that matches your style and brings out the best in your newly renovated space. 

HARDWARE, FIXTURES, AND MORE!

S&W offers a full range of hardware, fixtures, tubs, and more to help you create the bathroom you've been dreaming of.  Our design pros will help you select the right products for the way you live.
